# Vendored skill tree data

`gameSkillData.json` and `gameProgression.json` are copied unchanged from
[rossicler/enshrouded-skill-tree](https://github.com/rossicler/enshrouded-skill-tree)
(commit `4dc5df898234c1c2dc09bf8a264df2970a1634de`, `packages/core/src/constants/`), the open-source planner behind
[enshrouded-skill-tree.com](https://www.enshrouded-skill-tree.com/). They hold the Enshrouded 1.0
skill tree exported from the game files (game build 1267041): node positions, links, skill
costs, ranks and in-game text.

These files are licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0 or later (see `LICENSE`).
Everything generated from them for the skill planner (`public/assets/planner/`) and the
planner code (`src/planner.js`) is released under the same license.

Enshrouded and its game text are property of Keen Games GmbH.
